changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c inner join sys.tables t on c.object_id = t.object_id WHERE t.object_id = OBJECT_ID('Resource') and t.schema_id = schema_id('dbo') AND c.name = 'DateLastLoggedIn') begin alter table dbo.Resource drop column DateLastLoggedIn; end
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c inner join sys.tables t on c.object_id = t.object_id WHERE t.object_id = OBJECT_ID('Resource') and t.schema_id = schema_id('dbo') AND c.name = 'DateLastLoggedIn') begin alter table dbo.Resource add [DateLastLoggedIn] [datetime] NULL; end
